english.text: On the surface, America's economy is booming, inflation is edging down, unemployment is low, and economic growth is on track for 2.7 percent this year - double the rate of any other G7 country, according to the International Monetary Fund.

text: 表面上，美國經濟蓬勃發展，通脹逐漸噉下降緊，失業率比較低啲，而根據國際貨幣基金組織嘅數據，今年經濟增長正軌，將會達到2.7% ，係任何其他七國集團國家嘅一倍。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Do you notice that the Orbit gum's taste changed?" "Yes, it was better some years ago." "You homophobe." "What? Why do you call me like that?" "Don't deny it. You are a homophobe. You see a commercial two women kissing and you suddenly notice changes in taste of the product." "I didn't know about the commercial. But they really changed the taste." "Yeah, yeah, you think I believe you, you homophobe low life nothing."

jyutping: 「nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 gwai2 dou6 hau2 hoeng1 tong2 ge3 mei6 dou6 bin3 zo2？」「hai6 aa3，gei2 nin4 cin4 zung6 hou2 di1。」「nei5 go3 hung2 bou3 tung4 sing3 lyun2 ze2。」「me1？dim2 gaai2 nei5 gam2 giu3 ngo5？」「m4 hou2 fau2 jing6。nei5 hai6 go3 hung2 tung4 ze2。nei5 gin3 dou3 jat1 go3 gwong2 gou3 loeng5 go3 neoi5 jan4 sek3 gan2，nei5 zau6 wui6 dat6 jin4 faat3 jin6 caan2 ban2 ge3 mei6 dou6 jau5 bin3 faa3。」「ngo5 m4 zi1 go3 gwong2 gou3。daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 zan1 hai6 goi2 bin3 zo2 mei6 dou6。」「hai6 aa3 hai6 aa3，nei5 ji5 wai4 ngo5 seon3 nei5，nei5 ni1 go3 hung2 tung4 dai1 saang1 wut6 mou5 je5。」
text: 「你有冇留意到軌道口香糖嘅味道變咗？」「係呀，幾年前仲好啲。」「你個恐怖同性戀者。」「咩？點解你噉叫我？」「唔好否認。你係個恐同者。你見到一個廣告兩個女人錫緊，你就會突然發現產品嘅味道有變化。」「我唔知個廣告。但係佢哋真係改變咗味道。」「係呀係呀，你以為我信你，你呢個恐同低生活冇嘢。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "If ever Tiber and the fields I see / washed by her waves, ere mingling with the brine, / and build the city which the Fates decree, / then kindred towns and neighbouring folk shall join, / yours in Epirus, in Hesperia mine, / and linked thenceforth in sorrow and in joy, / with Dardanus the founder of each line, / so let posterity its pains employ, / two nations, one in heart, shall make another Troy."

jyutping: 「tong2 joek6 jau5 jat1 jat6 ngo5 gin3 dou2 toi4 baak3 ho4 tung4 keoi5 loeng5 ngon6 ge3 tin4 je5，bei2 keoi5 ge3 long6 faa1 cung1 sai2，zung6 mei6 wan6 jap6 haam4 seoi2 zi1 cin4；tong2 joek6 ngo5 on3 ming6 wan6 so2 ding6，gin3 laap6 hei2 ne1 zo6 sing4 bong1；gam3 joeng2，can1 zuk6 zi1 sing4 tung4 leon4 gan6 man4 zuk6 zoeng1 wui5 lyun4 hap6，nei5 ge3 hai2 ji1 bei3 lou5 si1，ngo5 ge3 hai2 haak1 si1 paak3 lei5 aa3；cung4 ci2 zi1 hau6，loeng5 dei6 jan4 man4 hai2 bei1 soeng1 tung4 fun1 lok6 zung1 lin4 hai6 hei2 loi4，ji5 daat6 daat6 nou5 si1 zok3 wai4 loeng5 mak6 ge3 gung6 tung4 ci2 zou2；jyun6 hau6 sai3 zi2 syun1 zi3 lik6 jyu1 ci2，loeng5 go3 man4 zuk6 tung4 sam1 jat1 dak1，zoi3 zou6 gwo3 ling6 jat1 go3 dak6 lok6 ji1。」
text: 「倘若有一日我見到台伯河同佢兩岸嘅田野，畀佢嘅浪花沖洗，仲未混入鹹水之前；倘若我按命運所定，建立起呢座城邦；咁樣，親族之城同鄰近民族將會聯合，你嘅喺伊庇魯斯，我嘅喺赫斯珀里亞；從此之後，兩地人民喺悲傷同歡樂中連繫起來，以達達努斯作為兩脈嘅共同始祖；願後世子孫致力於此，兩個民族同心一德，再造過另一個特洛伊。」
